blurb: A flying troop carrier for six, the hover carrier: a pilot in the open cockpit, a door gunner on the deck and four on its benches

notes.model: Hover carrier (Meshy, owned: the owner's own model, owner 2026-11-16: "I made it on Meshy"; the owner's Drive, Meshy_AI_hover_carrier_topdown_1116164125_texture.glb; content/guns.json vehicles/hover_carrier.glb, 2026-11-16): an olive and white armoured hover carrier, 9.6 m long (the old box's length), 4.74 m wide and 2.38 m tall, built 10,000 triangles with a 2,479 one from 40 m and a 1024 px colour map. An open cockpit at the nose (one seat on the centre line behind a console), and behind its bulkhead an open sunken deck 6 m long between the hull's sides, a bench along each side of its back two-thirds (three cushions a side) and a rail over each side. The Quaternius Imperial it replaced is the fallback (vehicles/dropship.glb).
notes.half: Fitted to the hull (2026-11-16; measured on the model, slices of its triangles; the mount's frame is the model's plus the 0.35 m it hovers): 4.7 m wide (the box was 4.0), 9.6 m long (unchanged), and up to the hull's sides, 1.7 m (unchanged). Over the box: the side rails (to 2.4 m, thin bars) and the cockpit's shell and bulkhead (2.2-2.7 m), not solid, like the Hauler's fins. The deck inside is open: its floor is 0.65 m up, so a rider is inside the box, and shots reach riders through the open hull (openHull) as on any open vehicle.
notes.seats: Measured on the model: the cockpit's seat on the centre line, its cushion 1.5 m up at z 2.65 (the backrest behind it to 2.7 m at z 2.0-2.4, the footwell 1.05 m up at z 3.0-3.4, the console to 2.1 m at z 3.8-4.4). The deck's floor 0.65 m up from z 1.75 back to -4.3, between the hull's sides at x ±2.0 (1.65 m up, rails to 2.4); each bench from z -0.2 to -4.0, its front edge at x ±1.0, its cushion 1.2 m up and its backrest to 1.56 m at x ±1.6. The pilot sits in the cockpit (legDrop the default 0.45 to the footwell). The door gunner stands on the deck's open front (z 0.8), eye 2.25 m up: over the sides (1.65) and the tailgate (2.34), and can duck under them; the cockpit's bulkhead (2.7 m) hides a narrow wedge dead ahead, which the pilot's view covers. The four riders sit on the benches facing in (backs to the hull), each on an end cushion (x ±1.3, z -1.0 and -3.0: the bench's three cushions run from z -0.25 to -3.75, the end ones centred at -0.83 and -3.17), feet toward the floor 0.55 m below. Checked 2026-11-17 on the drawn model in the game (rays down at each rider's hips): the cushions' tops are 1.24-1.26 m up and the floor 0.74 m in the drawn frame; the seated hips ride 0.07-0.17 m over the cushion (the hip joint sits that far inside the body, as on the buggy's seats), so the places stay at 1.2 m with legDrop 0.55 (1.25 put the hips 0.12-0.22 over it). What read as standing: a rider is drawn facing its aim with its hips turned back to the seat at most the waist's 77 degrees, so one looking along the hull or out over the side had its legs swung off the cushion; it is now drawn turned no further from its seat's way than the waist turns (riderPlacement.ts seatDrawnYaw), so its legs stay on the cushion. Their seated eyes (2.2 m) clear the sides. Roles, the gun and its all-round arc unchanged. They stood on the old model's flat top.
notes.enterRadius: 4.5 m, unchanged: the hull reach (sim/mounts.ts enterReach, ENTER_HULL_REACH) lets a player in from anywhere along its sides, nose and tail; the wider hull (2.35 m a side) is inside the radius at its middle.
notes.cockpitEye: A seated head height over the cockpit's cushion (2.45 m up, a little forward): over the console (2.1 m) and between the cockpit's side pods (2.2-2.5 m); the nose is low in the view.
notes.paint: Half strength (2026-11-17; owner's screenshot of a team-owned Dropship, "looks broken"): the full team colour multiplied over the model's olive and white turned the olive near black and the white into flat team colour (Shingle Point's blue: a dark, black and blue box from above). At 0.5 the olive and white stay and the team colour reads as a cast over them; the open deck and benches seen from above are the model's own (an open carrier, no roof).
